svg.aria-label: Architecture of the serverless web application
svg.title: Architecture of the serverless web application

g.text: 1 Browser loads the form · 2 Browser sends PUT /productpurchase · 3 API Gateway invokes Lambda
4 Lambda puts a message in the queue · 5 SQS trigger invokes Lambda · 6 Lambda writes the item
7 API Gateway returns the response to the browser (dashed arrow)
